record.original_question: For the p-frame energy I_F(μ)=∫∫|⟨x,y⟩|^p dμ(x)dμ(y) on the sphere S^{d−1}, if p>2 and p is not an even integer, must every minimizing measure be discrete?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.1 (D. Bilyk, A. Glazyrin, R. Matzke, J. Park, O. Vlasiuk, [3, 4]). For p > 2 and p ̸= 2k, k ∈ N, all minimizers of the p-frame energy are discrete measures.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^{d-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ denote the unit sphere, and let $\mathcal{P}(S^{d-1})$ denote the set of Borel probability measures on $S^{d-1}$. For a real number $p > 0$, define the $p$-frame energy of $\mu \in \mathcal{P}(S^{d-1})$ by
$$I_p(\mu) = \int_{S^{d-1}} \int_{S^{d-1}} |\langle x, y \rangle|^p \, d\mu(x)\, d\mu(y).$$
A measure $\mu^* \in \mathcal{P}(S^{d-1})$ is called a minimizer if $I_p(\mu^*) = \inf_{\mu \in \mathcal{P}(S^{d-1})} I_p(\mu)$. A measure is said to be discrete if its support is a finite (or countable) set of points.

Prove or disprove: for every integer $d \geq 2$ and every real $p > 2$ with $p \notin \{2k : k \in \mathbb{N}\}$, every minimizer $\mu^*$ of $I_p$ on $S^{d-1}$ is a discrete measure.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears to remain open in full generality. Bilyk, Glazyrin, Matzke, Park, and Vlasiuk proved that for non-even integer p, the support of any minimizer of the p-frame energy has empty interior, which is partial progress but does not establish discreteness. Existence of discrete minimizers has been established for related classes (e.g., polynomial potentials), and computational/experimental work has explored minimizers, but a complete proof of discreteness for all p > 2 with p not an even integer is not reported.

status_evidence.title: Energy on spheres and discreteness of minimizing measures
status_evidence.snippet: Authors prove the support of any minimizer of the p-frame energy has empty interior whenever p is not an even integer.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: empty-interior support, not full discreteness.

status_evidence.title: Experimental Survey of Discrete Minimizers of the p-frame Energy
status_evidence.snippet: Computational exploration of point configurations minimizing p-frame energies, revealing phase-transition behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture investigated experimentally; remains an active research topic.
